Class ContentManager

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Content
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Manages loading, caching, and unloading of various content types (textures, shaders, fonts, sounds, etc.) from disk and content packs for the game. Provides methods to retrieve and manage content efficiently.

ContentManager(string)

Initializes a new instance of the ContentManager class with the specified root directory.

public ContentManager(string rootDirectory)

Parameters

rootDirectory string

The root directory for all content managed by this ContentManager.

Remarks

The rootDirectory parameter specifies the base directory from which all content paths are resolved. It acts as the root for loading, caching, and managing content files. All relative file paths used by the ContentManager are interpreted with respect to this directory. If a relative path used for loading a resource contains the RootDirectory, the RootDirectory will be stripped from the path before further processing. If no content pack is found for a given relative path, the ContentManager will attempt to load the resource directly from the file system using the combined path of RootDirectory and the relative path.

UnloadAllContentPacks()

Unloads all content packs by calling Clear() on each loaded ContentPack. Does not remove the content packs from the manager; use RemoveAllContentPacks(bool) to remove them.

public void UnloadAllContentPacks()

UnloadContent()

Unloads all cached content (shaders, textures, images, fonts, waves, sounds, music streams, and texts) from the ContentManager, releasing their resources. Logs each unload operation.

public void UnloadContent()
